name: What are the signs that my water heater pressure relief valve needs replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my water heater pressure relief valve needs replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key indicators that your water heater's pressure relief valve needs replacement include constant dripping or a continuous stream of water from the discharge pipe, visible corrosion or mineral buildup on the valve itself, or if the valve fails to open when manually tested. While a small amount of discharge after heating can be normal, persistent leaking suggests the valve is stuck open or has failed. If you observe any of these issues, especially a steady drip, it's best to contact a plumbing professional to assess the valve and determine if replacement is necessary.
